当我们抵达虚境时、我们通灵者的内心响起了一阵齐声。最开始只是轻柔的低语，随后变为强烈的刺耳声，一千道声音开始齐声讲述。

这些声音自称虚空之低语。合唱中的每个个体都感应到：秘密的低语、空置之御座、人偶的大师，有许多许多的存在都加入了低语的合唱。祂——祂们——宣称通晓所有凡人向另一个凡人低语的秘密知识，并且愿意和我们分享这些知识……

texts.en:
As we reach into the Shroud, the minds of our telepaths are filled with a chorus of voices. No more than soft whispers at first, the cacophony grows in intensity, a thousand voices speaking in unison.

The voices introduce themselves as the Whisperers in the Void. Individual members of the chorus make themselves known: the Susurrus of Secrets, the Vacant Throne, the Master of Puppets - there are so many of them, all joined in the chorus of the Whisperers. It - they - claim to be privy to all knowledge whispered in secrecy from one mortal to another, and offer to share some of these secrets with us...

If we will only allow them into our consciousness.

A trifling price, they assure us. We will barely even notice their presence.

There is an urgency to their tone.

label.en: Form a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void.

tooltips.en: There will be a price to pay.

tooltips.zh: 我们的[GetChosenCivicName]国民理念将被移除。
我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。

notes.zh: 这是虚空之低语的立约提案；三个选项互斥：立约 / 拒绝（永不再提）/ 自寻出路（天选之国不可选）。
notes.en: Covenant offer of the Whisperers in the Void; the three options are exclusive: covenant / refuse (never offered again) / forge our own path (not for a chosen empire).

texts.zh:
我们与一位名为虚空之低语的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着莫测的感觉，它索取一定代价承诺赐予我们零星力量。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果将我们的行为与超主保持一致，这条纽带将更容易被加强。

低语享受新的知识、沉默的秘密和阴谋。祂们陶醉于一种简单的快乐，这种快乐充满了头脑，在接缝处开裂。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Whisperers in the Void. Unfathomable, it promises to grant us crumbs of power for a price.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Whisperers enjoy new knowledge, silent secrets, and conspiracies. They revel in the simple joy of a mind filled to the brim, cracking at the seams.

texts.zh:
完成了。我们与虚空之低语签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个[root.GetName]。

新超主的影响出现得非常迅速。随着我们的集体等待着隐秘知识的汇入，我们感觉到了自己的思想分支成了不同的模式。[GetNetworkName]的稳态和谐被内心越来越不统一的声音所覆盖。

这就是强大纽带的代价。据[GetTelepathPlural]称，低语最强的庇佑还没到来。我们与这种强大的灵能实体直接交流毫无疑问非常值得。
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void. Their will courses through the [root.GetName].

The influence of our new patron has taken hold swiftly. As our collective awaits an influx of hidden knowledge, we sense our thoughts splintering into divergent patterns. The steady harmony of the [GetNetworkName] is overlaid with a growing discord of inner voices.

Such is the price of this powerful bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Whisperers' greatest blessings are yet to come. Our direct communion with such a magnificent psionic entity will surely have been worth it.

texts.zh:
自从与虚空之低语签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]确定，有了这一正式承诺就能主动地利用超主所提供的力量，增强我们的舰队和灵能光环。
texts.en:
Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the Whisperers in the Void. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

texts.zh:
我们的超主，[GetShroudPatron]，从虚境中沉积出了一小份能量以备取用。与超主的紧密关系让我们能安全吸收这些能量。

我们挑选了一些候选人，但只有其中一位可以得到获得汲取超主力量的殊荣。我们必须做出抉择。
texts.en:
Our patron, the [GetShroudPatron], has deposited a fraction of its energy in a fold of the Shroud, ready for the taking. Our close bond will allow one of us to safely absorb this power.

A number of candidates have been selected, but only one of them can be granted the privilege to wield the power of our patron. We must decide who it shall be.

texts.zh: 完成了。随着力量被注入到[chosen_leader.GetName]体内，身旁的人们都能[GetFeelLoc]到这灵能显昭的分量，这让他们肃然起敬。[chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap]现在成为了[GetImmortalLoc]的[This.GetName]虚境塑造者。
texts.en: It is done. As the power was invested in [chosen_leader.GetName], all those around could [GetFeelLoc] the weight of its psionic presence. It is powerful and commands respect. [chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap] will now be the [GetImmortalLoc]  Shroudshaper of the [This.GetName].

texts.zh: 这次事件给[previous_chosen_leader.GetName]，一位曾被旧主选中的异端，带来了毁灭性打击。在[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]的流放地，随着最后一丝灵能从[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]支离破碎的躯体中消散，这位异端的生命也随之走到了尽头。
texts.en: The event had a devastating effect on the heretic [previous_chosen_leader.GetName], once considered the Chosen of our former patron. From [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] place of exile, [previous_chosen_leader.GetHeShe] quietly expired when the last traces of psionic power ebbed from [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] broken form.

texts.zh: 该事件对[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]产生了显著影响。尽管[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe]依旧蕴含强大的灵能能量，却失去了昔日由旧主庇护在[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer]躯体中赋予的力量。
texts.en: The event had a noticeable effect on [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]. Though still imbued with considerable psionic energy, [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe] [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHasHave] lost the power once bestowed in [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer] by our former patron.

label.en: They were destined to be Chosen.

label.en: A covenant Chosen One leader; not a megacorp; MTTH 10 years

texts.zh:
虚境中的无数实体都拥有着强大的力量。想要得到祂们最大限度的庇佑，必须先与祂们形成不可撤销的纽带。

然而我们看到了自己的实现方法。我们不仅可以将心灵与单一超主绑定，还能让[GetResearchers]找到从每个实体中汲取少量能量、甚至按照我们的意志重塑虚境的方法。
texts.en:
The entities within the Shroud are many, each an accretion of great power. They expect an irrevocable bond before they bestow their greatest blessings.

Yet we see a way to forge our own path. Rather than binding our psyches to a single patron, our psionic [GetResearchers] can develop the means to channel smaller amounts of energy from each, shaping the Shroud to our own will.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetResearchers]开发出了一种从虚境里抽取能量的绝妙方法。

灵能界中最强大的能量被超主们所看守，只有签订了契约的能分一杯羹。这是我们不能接受的；我们找到了一条属于自己的路。

将我们的意志投射到虚境中，就能从调和的灵域中抽取少量能量。这需要高度集中注意，但我们的意志现在已经足够坚强来维持这种精妙的平衡了。
texts.en:
Our psionic [GetResearchers] have developed a clever technique for drawing power from the Shroud.

The greatest powers in the psionic realm are kept secret by its patrons, given only at the price of a Covenant. This, we could not do; we have found a way to forge our own path.

By projecting our will into the Shroud, we can siphon smaller amounts of power from each of its domains of attunement. Doing so will require heavy concentration, but our minds are now fortified to maintain this delicate balance.

label.zh: 在虚境中，我们的意志是自由的。
label.en: Within the Shroud, our will is our own.

texts.zh:
在一个虚境的褶皱中，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]发现了一汪未被触及的能量核心。

汇聚性的能量会在灵能界中逐渐聚集——聚集到足够的强度之后，总有一天会孕育出强大的实体。我们发现的正是这样的一处集中点，等待着我们汲取。

通过灵能意志的力量，可以让我们中的一个以吸收这种非凡的力量。现已选出了一些候选人。
texts.en:
In a fold of the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] have discovered a nexus of untapped power.

Convergent forces can gradually accumulate in the psionic realm - powerful concentrations of energy that might, one day, mature into greater entities. We have discovered one such gathering, ready for the taking.

By force of sheer psionic will, one among us can absorb this extraordinary strength. A number of candidates have been selected.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂呢喃着给出提案。虚空之低语打算将我们的一个殖民地重塑成遗落星球；我们只需要做出决定即可。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it murmurs with an offer. The Whisperers in the Void will reimagine one of our colonies as a Relic World; we need only make our choice.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂呢喃着给出提案。虚空之低语将在阿卡西记录与我们的一艘方舟舰之间建立链接，低声地讲述出一切曾经存在或终将存在之物的记忆；我们只需要做出决定即可。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it murmurs with an offer. The Whisperers in the Void will open a link between the Akashic Records and one of our Arkships, whispering memories of all that has ever been or ever will be; we need only make our choice.

# 虚空之低语 / The Whisperers in the Void

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:11250-11349 (shroud.4700)`; `events/shroud_events.txt:11351-11367 (shroud.4705/4710)`; `common/patrons/patron_types.txt:851 (covenant_event)`; `common/inline_scripts/shroud/patron_covenant_proposition_event.txt`; `common/inline_scripts/shroud/patron_covenant_confirmation_event.txt`; `common/inline_scripts/shroud/patron_covenant_formed_event.txt`; `common/inline_scripts/shroud/accept_covenant.txt`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:163 (@covenant_confirmation_time_days = 360)`; `events/utopia_on_action_events.txt:3320-3348 (utopia.2679), 3435 (2681), 3593 (2682)`; `common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt:572-585 (SHROUD_SHAPING_PROJECT)`; `events/shroud_events.txt:8162-8305 (3500/3510)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

由游戏引擎通过赞助者定义中的 covenant_event = shroud.4700 发起（common/patrons/patron_types.txt 851 行），即在虚境中与虚空之低语的关系达到可立约时，以外交窗口提出契约。

Launched by the engine through covenant_event = shroud.4700 in the patron definition (common/patrons/patron_types.txt lines 851): when the relationship with the Whisperers in the Void allows a covenant, it is offered in a diplomatic window.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

接受：立约（accept_covenant），开始“虚空之低语”事件链（机器人帝国用 robot_ 版本），立即显示 4705“签订契约”，并在360天后安排 4710“坚振圣事”。确认：获得标记科技与协约能力，30–90天后经隐藏的 utopia.2679 检查（需超过一名合适领袖，否则每30天重试）进入 utopia.2681“力量碎片”，选出一位领袖成为天选者（2682“升华”）。弃约：结束事件链并重置契合度。两个窗口中都可“自寻出路”：开启“塑造虚境”社会学项目（10000），完成后 3500“开辟道路”，60–90天后 3510 同样选出一位领袖（2682）。

Accept: the covenant is formed (accept_covenant), the Whisperers in the Void event chain begins (robot_ variant for robot empires), 4705 "Covenant Formed" shows at once and 4710 "A Confirmation" is scheduled 360 days later. Confirming grants the mark technology and covenant powers; 30–90 days later hidden utopia.2679 checks for more than one suitable leader (else retries every 30 days) and opens utopia.2681 "Scraps of Power" to make one leader the Chosen (2682 "Ascended"). Renouncing ends the chain and resets attunement. Both windows offer "forge our own path": the Shaping the Shroud society project (10000), then 3500 "A Path Forged" and 60–90 days later 3510, which likewise elevates a leader (2682).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

虚空低语者的提案是单独写成的：接受时若为“天选之国”会失去天选国民理念；拒绝时获得五级的物理/社会/工程研究与泽珞奖励；“自寻出路”只在从未立约过时出现。 拒绝选项：拒绝立约并重置契合度，提示“永不再提”。立约后可激活“顾后”协约（patron_types.txt 979–992 → 4890），在候选殖民地中选择一处改造为遗迹世界（游牧帝国为方舟连接阿卡夏记录）。它作为本故事的次级入口出现。

The Whisperers proposal is written out separately: accepting removes the Chosen civic from a chosen empire; refusing grants tier-5 physics/society/engineering research and zro; "forge our own path" appears only if the empire never established a covenant. The refusal option rejects the covenant and resets attunement ("never again"). After the covenant the Hindsight accord can be activated (patron_types.txt 979–992 → 4890): choose one candidate colony to become a Relic World (for nomads, an Arkship linked to the Akashic Records). It appears as a secondary entry of this story.
